R0221.name: Apply, pass practice test, take tests
R0221.payout_text: $10 per 15-20 min test; $4 short tests; $30-$120 live interviews
R0221.payout_timing: PayPal, usually 14 days after the test; no minimum

steps.text: Go to https://usertesting.com/be-a-user-tester and enter your email address to start the application.
Complete the applicant checklist: take the short practice test (unpaid) — on a computer no download is needed; on a phone, download the UserTesting app from the App Store or Google Play first.
Create your account with your name, username, password, and zip code, and link a verified PayPal account.
Wait for your first test to be manually reviewed and scored — only then can you take more tests.
Check your dashboard for available tests; every listing shows the exact amount you will be paid before you accept.
Complete the test: follow the tasks, speak your thoughts aloud clearly, and upload the recording.
Your payment is sent to PayPal, usually 14 days after you complete the test — track it under Test history.

catches: Test availability is inconsistent and demographic-gated — most contributors get only a few tests per week.
The practice test is unpaid and your first real test is manually reviewed before you can take more.
You must wait about 14 days after each test for the PayPal payment.
Payments can be cancelled if the customer is dissatisfied and the quality review upholds it.
UserTesting does not withhold taxes — you are responsible for reporting the income.

R0220.name: Sign up, complete profile, participate in studies
R0220.payout_text: At least $8/hr — researchers must pay a minimum of £6/$8 per hour
R0220.payout_timing: Paid after researcher approves; cash out from $6/£6 via PayPal

steps.text: Go to https://www.prolific.com/participants and click Sign up to join the waitlist (about 3 minutes: email, password, basic info).
Watch for the invite email and accept it when tasks become available for your profile.
Verify your identity with a photo ID (about 15 minutes) and complete the short practice task.
Fill out the 'About you' profile questions — these decide which studies you are offered.
Open your Studies dashboard, pick a study, and check its stated reward and estimated time before starting.
Complete the study in one sitting, following the instructions, then submit your responses.
Once the researcher approves and your balance reaches $6/£6, cash out from your Prolific account to PayPal.

catches: New signups currently join a waitlist — you are invited only when tasks are available.
Study flow depends on researcher demand matching your demographics; earnings are not steady.
Researchers can reject submissions, which means no pay for that study.
Some studies may effectively underpay if they take longer than the researcher's estimate (Prolific polices this via median-time recalculation).

R0292.name: Sign up, review case materials, submit verdict
R0292.payout_text: Typical pay is $30-$350. (Terms: 'I will only be paid for each case review that I complete. I will be informed ahead of time what the payment terms for that case will be.')
R0292.payout_timing: Not stated in the official terms — you are only told you will be informed of the payment terms for each case ahead of time.

steps.text: Go to https://www.onlineverdict.com/jurors/signup/ and fill in the form: first and last name, email, state, county, cell phone, date of birth, and annual household income.
Read and agree to the Terms and Conditions (confidentiality, only you participate under your profile, paid only if you answer all questions).
Wait for an email or text when a case is posted in your area — participation is 100% optional.
If you are available, complete the case screener; if you match the demographics, your spot in the study is confirmed.
Review the case materials (surveys, Zoom presentations, or in-person sessions) and answer every case question thoroughly and completely.
Note the payment terms you are told ahead of time for that specific case (typical pay $30-$350, varies by study length).
Make sure your correct name and mailing address are registered on the site so your payment reaches you.

catches: Cases are only offered in your venue and only if you match the demographics the case needs — income is irregular.
You are only paid if you answer ALL case questions asked of you.
OnlineVerdict may terminate your participation at any time, without prior notice, for any reason.
Payment terms are set per case and disclosed in advance, so there is no guaranteed rate.
Payment requires your correct name and mailing address on file (implies mailed payment); payment timing is not stated in the terms.

R0140.name: Sign up, link card or click through before shopping, scan receipts, earn cash back on planned purchases
R0140.payout_text: Regardless of whether they are expressed as points or dollar amounts, Rewards have no cash, monetary, or other value and are only redeemable for gift cards or other prizes or redemption methods as may be offered by the Rewards Program from time to time. Official rewards store: $10 gift card = 1,000 SB.
R0140.payout_timing: Redemption processing times vary; digital gift cards may take up to 10 business days (usually arrive sooner).

steps.text: Go to https://www.swagbucks.com and sign up free with your email and password (must be 13+; under 18 needs a parent's approval).
Optionally install the Swagbucks app on Android for surveys and activities on the go.
Earn SB by completing surveys, using the Swagbucks search engine, watching videos, shopping through the portal, or playing games.
Watch your SB balance grow in your account dashboard (100 SB is worth about $1).
When ready, open the Rewards / Redeem section and choose a gift card (Amazon, Walmart, Target, etc.) or PayPal.
Confirm the redemption; complete identity verification if Swagbucks asks (photo ID or phone verification).
Receive your digital gift card or PayPal credit — rewards can take up to 10 business days, usually sooner.

catches: SB have no cash, monetary, or other value; redeemable only for whatever redemption prizes Swagbucks offers at the time
Company may change, suspend, or cancel the program including unredeemed Rewards at any time without notice or compensation
Account closed if inactive for 12 consecutive months (no login, redemption, or new earnings)
Redemption prizes may be limited / while supplies last; no reversals or refunds after redemption
Identity verification (photo ID, phone) can be required before redemption
Must be 13+; under 18 needs parent/guardian approval

R0119.name: Sign up, link card or click through before shopping, scan receipts, earn cash back on planned purchases
R0119.payout_text: Points for scanning receipts (25+ pts/receipt); converts to gift cards
R0119.payout_timing: Points credited within minutes to hours; $3 gift cards available after a first $10+ redemption; redemption takes up to 72 hours

steps.text: Download the official Fetch Rewards app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store (free).
Open the app and create an account with your email (or Google/Facebook login); provide your name and a valid mobile phone number.
Optionally enter a friend's referral code on the signup screen for bonus points.
After any grocery, restaurant, gas, or retail purchase, tap the camera icon in the app and photograph the full receipt within 14 days.
Optionally link your email and Amazon accounts under the eReceipts section so online purchase receipts earn automatically.
Check the Special Offers tab for bonus-point offers on specific brands before you shop.
Once your balance reaches at least 3,000 points, open the Rewards tab, pick a gift card (e.g. $3 Amazon), tap Get My Reward, and find the gift card under My Rewards / your email.

catches: Points expire after 90 days of inactivity (60-day warning by email/text)
Receipts must be scanned within 14 calendar days of purchase
Points have no cash value and cannot be redeemed for cash, transferred, or combined
Minimum Redemption Amount can change at any time at Fetch's sole discretion
Fetch may limit the number of receipts processed in a time period
Only one account per person; fake receipts or multiple accounts lead to termination

R0118.name: Sign up, link card or click through before shopping, scan receipts, earn cash back on planned purchases
R0118.payout_text: Cash back on grocery and retail purchases (activate offers before buying)
R0118.payout_timing: Receipt credit within 48h; $20 minimum cash-out via bank transfer (Plaid), PayPal, or gift cards; first redemption needs 1+ offer redeemed and a 7-day wait

steps.text: Download the official Ibotta app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store (free).
Create a free Ibotta account with your email.
Verify your phone number: tap Profile (top left) > Verify device > Link your phone number, enter the code texted to you.
Before shopping, browse offers in the app and tap the (+) on each product offer to add it to your list.
Shop at the store as normal and keep your paper receipt (or link your store loyalty card for automatic tracking).
In the app, open the retailer page and tap Submit receipt, then photograph the full receipt.
Once your balance reaches $20.00 and you have redeemed at least one offer, tap the Earnings icon (top right) > Withdraw.
Choose bank account, PayPal, or gift card; tap Review, then Confirm & withdraw.

catches: $20.00 minimum withdrawal threshold; must also redeem at least one qualifying offer
New accounts: 7-day wait after first offer redemption before first withdrawal
$3.99 account maintenance fee per 30 days after 180 days of inactivity
Phone number verification required before withdrawing
One account per person/device; submitting others' receipts leads to deactivation
Some gift cards have a $25 minimum purchase

R0116.name: Sign up, link card or click through before shopping, scan receipts, earn cash back on planned purchases
R0116.payout_timing: Cash back confirms in 3-14 weeks; paid quarterly via check or PayPal (Feb 15 / May 15 / Aug 15 / Nov 15); $5.01 minimum to be paid

steps.text: Go to https://www.rakuten.com and create a free account with your email (you must be 18+ and a US resident).
Install the Rakuten browser extension or the Rakuten mobile app for automatic cash-back activation.
When you want to shop online, start at Rakuten.com or the app, search for the store, and click through to it.
Complete your purchase in the same browsing session without visiting other sites or applying coupons not listed by Rakuten.
Your cash back posts to your Rakuten balance after the store confirms the purchase (timing varies; travel posts after the trip).
In Account Settings, choose how you want to be paid: PayPal, check, or gift card, and make sure your mailing address is on file.
Each quarter (February, May, August, November), Rakuten sends your payment as long as your balance is at least $5.01; smaller balances roll over.

catches: Cash back only on net purchase amount — excludes taxes, fees, shipping, gift-wrapping, discounts, returns, extended warranties
Gift card purchases may not qualify if excluded by the store's offer terms
Must start at Rakuten and complete purchase in the same session; visiting other sites or using outside coupons can void the cash back
Cookies must be enabled or no cash back is tracked
Rates and participating stores can change; Rakuten is not responsible if a store withdraws or modifies an offer
One account per person; fraudulent/abusive redemptions can be denied and account terminated

R0446.name: Answer short surveys, earn Google Play credit
R0446.payout_text: Up to $1.00 in Google Play credit per survey
R0446.payout_timing: Credit added when the survey is completed

steps.text: On Android, open the Play Store and install 'Google Opinion Rewards' by Google LLC; on iPhone, install it from the App Store.
Open the app and sign in with your Google account (on iOS, connect your PayPal account during setup).
Answer the initial profile questions about yourself (age, gender, location, interests) so surveys can be matched to you.
Turn on notifications — surveys arrive about once a week and can expire quickly.
When a survey notification arrives, open it and answer the questions honestly (most take 10-30 seconds).
Your credit (up to $1.00 per survey) is added to your Play balance on Android, or accumulates toward PayPal payout on iOS.
On Android, spend the credit in the Play Store — it applies automatically at checkout for apps, games, movies, or subscriptions.

catches: Surveys arrive roughly once a week and availability is inconsistent — you cannot count on volume.
On Android, rewards are Google Play credit only; they cannot be transferred to a bank account or PayPal.
The per-survey amount is small (a few cents up to $1.00).

The old consumer web page (surveys.google.com/opinion-rewards) now redirects to a Google Surveys sunset notice — the app is the product, and Google confirms the Opinion Rewards app itself is not going away.

R0355.name: Search on Bing daily, browse with Edge, earn points
R0355.payout_text: 5 pts per Bing search, 150/day cap; gift cards from 1,600 pts
R0355.payout_timing: Redeem when you hit the point thresholds

steps.text: Create a free Microsoft account (or sign in with your existing Outlook/Xbox/Windows account).
Go to https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/rewards/about and click Start earning, then visit the Rewards dashboard to fully activate your account.
Stay signed in to your Microsoft account in the Microsoft Edge browser and on Bing.
Earn points daily: search with Bing on PC (up to 150 points/day at Level 2) and on mobile via the Bing app.
Complete the daily quizzes, polls, and streak activities on your Rewards dashboard for bonus points.
Keep earning at least 500 points per month to reach and hold Level 2 for better rates.
Once you reach 1,600+ points, open the Rewards catalog and redeem for a Microsoft Store/Xbox gift card (or save to 5,000 for top-retailer gift cards).

catches: Point earning limits apply: PC search capped per day (50 Level 1 / 150 Level 2); mobile search capped at 100/day at Level 2
Level 2 requires earning at least 500 points per month
Microsoft Store purchases: subscriptions and gift card purchases are not eligible; 20,000 points/month cap on purchase earnings
Rewards with Xbox through gameplay require age 18+ with a Microsoft account in select markets
Available only in listed markets (market list linked on page, not enumerated inline)

R0295.name: Search by name and state, file claim with documentation
R0295.payout_text: Once verified you will receive your unclaimed property. / $3+ Billion in paid claims in the last year / $2,080 is the average claim value
R0295.payout_timing: Not stated on the official page; varies by state, commonly weeks to months.

steps.text: Go to https://missingmoney.com/ in your browser.
Type your last name (or business name) and first name into the search boxes and tap Search.
Repeat the search for every state you have lived or worked in; also try previous names and common misspellings (the site explicitly recommends this).
Open any match and check the details (old address, holder name) to confirm the property is really yours.
Tap through to initiate the claim — the site redirects you to the official state treasury/controller website holding the funds.
Submit the state's claim form with your photo ID and proof of address directly to the state.
Wait for the state to verify and pay you; check back often since new properties are added daily.

catches: Only finds money if unclaimed property exists in your name — most searches return no match.
Hawaii does not participate in MissingMoney.com (the site links you to Hawaii's own system).
You file the actual claim with the state treasury/controller holding the funds, not with MissingMoney — the state requires ID and proof of address.
No payout timeline is published; state processing commonly takes weeks to months.

R0302.name: Search settlement databases, file claim with proof of purchase
R0302.payout_text: The FTC enforces consumer protection laws to stop illegal business practices and get refunds to people who lost money. The chart below includes all active refund programs managed by the FTC.
R0302.payout_timing: Varies by case; typically months after the final court approval hearing.

steps.text: Go to https://www.ftc.gov/enforcement/refunds and scan the Active Refund Programs table for a company or product you used.
For non-FTC class actions, search the web for the case name plus 'official settlement website' — open the administrator's site (Epiq, Kroll, JND, etc.), never a random blog.
On the official settlement website, read the class definition to confirm you qualify (dates, product, state).
Check the claim deadline and what proof is required (receipt, account email, or no proof needed).
Fill out the official online claim form with truthful information — false claims can be rejected and may lead to penalties.
Choose your payment method if offered (check, PayPal, Venmo, prepaid card).
Save your confirmation number and wait — payments typically arrive months after the final approval hearing.

catches: No single official database covers every class action — the FTC page covers FTC-administered cases only; other cases live on their own official settlement websites.
Third-party aggregator sites are leads only — always file on the official settlement website run by the court-appointed administrator.
Each case has a hard claim deadline; missing it means no payout.
Payouts are often small (single-digit to tens of dollars for consumer cases) and arrive months after the final approval hearing.
Scam sites mimic settlement notices — the FTC states it will never threaten you, demand money to release a refund, or promise a prize.

R0098.name: Open account via referral/promo link, verify identity, link bank, complete qualifying actions
R0098.payout_text: Referral bonus: your friend gets $100, you earn a bonus
R0098.payout_timing: After all three qualifying steps complete

steps.text: Get a current Chime member's referral link — the bonus only works if you sign up through it; it cannot be added later.
Tap the referral link, download the Chime app (search 'Chime – Mobile Banking' in the App Store or Google Play, developer Chime), and open a Chime Checking Account.
Complete identity verification (name, address, Social Security number) and finish signup through the referral link.
When your physical Chime Visa Debit Card arrives in the mail, keep it — you will need to activate it.
Set up a qualifying direct deposit: in the Chime app find your account and routing numbers, and give them to your employer/payroll or gig platform for a deposit of $200 or more.
Make sure that $200+ deposit lands within 45 days of opening the account.
Activate your physical card in the app within 14 calendar days of that deposit landing. The $100 bonus is paid once all three conditions are met.

catches: No referral link used at signup = no bonus, and it cannot be added later.
The $200+ deposit must be a single qualifying direct deposit within 45 days of opening — payroll/gig/government ACH; bank transfers, PayPal/Venmo, and cash loads do not count.
You must activate the physical Chime Visa Debit Card within 14 calendar days of that qualifying deposit.
The referrer's bonus amount varies based on their active offer — it is not a fixed $100 for them.
Maximum 10 successful referral rewards per calendar year.
Bonus is taxable income (reported on 1099-INT for new members; 1099-MISC for referrers at $600+).

R0096.name: Open account via referral/promo link, verify identity, link bank, complete qualifying actions
R0096.payout_timing: Within 7 business days of completing requirements

steps.text: Go to https://sofi.com/banking/checking-offer/ and tap 'Open an account' to start a SoFi Checking and Savings application (or start it in the SoFi app).
Complete the application with your name, address, Social Security number, and a valid photo ID.
Once approved, find your SoFi account and routing numbers in the app under your checking account details.
Give those numbers to your employer's payroll (or pension/benefits provider) to set up direct deposit — it must be real payroll/pension/government ACH, not a transfer from another bank or app.
Make sure your first eligible direct deposit of at least $1 arrives on or before 12/31/26 — this starts your 25-calendar-day bonus measurement window.
Within those 25 calendar days, get your total eligible direct deposits to at least $1,000 ($50 bonus) or $5,000+ ($400 bonus).
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus lands in your SoFi Checking account within 7 business days after the requirements are complete.

catches: The $400 tier needs $5,000+ in qualifying direct deposits within 25 calendar days of your first eligible deposit — most people land the $50 tier.
Only recurring payroll/pension/government-benefit ACH counts; Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, Wise, wires, bank ACH transfers, tax refunds, and check deposits are excluded.
SoFi reserves the right to modify or end the promotion at any time without notice.
Bonus is taxable income (may be reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC).
First eligible direct deposit must be received on or before 12/31/26; promotion runs 5/15/2026–12/31/2026.
Account must be open and in good standing at the time of bonus payment; one bonus per member.

R0036.name: Open account, fund, set up direct deposit, meet requirements, hold through early-closure period
R0036.payout_timing: Deposited within 15 days after completing all offer requirements

steps.text: Go to the official Chase offer page https://account.chase.com/consumer/banking/seo and enroll — this registers your coupon for the $400 bonus (applying from the regular Chase homepage will not qualify).
Complete the online application for a Chase Total Checking account and get approved; save the confirmation email with your coupon code.
Note your coupon enrollment date — your direct-deposit qualification window runs from that date.
In the Chase Mobile app or at chase.com, find your new account and routing numbers.

Ask your employer's payroll (or pension/government benefits provider) to direct-deposit your paycheck there until deposits total $1,000+ within 90 days of coupon enrollment — Zelle, Venmo, and bank-to-bank transfers do not count.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $400 bonus is deposited within 15 days after you complete the requirements.
To avoid the $15 monthly fee, keep $500+ in qualifying electronic deposits per statement period (your bonus-run deposits cover this) or meet another fee waiver.

catches: You must enroll through the offer/coupon page — opening from the regular Chase homepage or in a branch without the coupon does not qualify.

The qualifying condition (direct deposits totaling $1,000+ within 90 days of coupon enrollment) is stated on 'your offer' per Chase; the official page FAQ confirms the $400 bonus, 15-day payout, and eligibility rules.
The account has a $15 monthly service fee unless waived ($500+ in qualifying electronic deposits, $1,500+ daily balance, or other waiver).
Zelle, microdeposits, bank-to-bank transfers, tax refunds, dividends, and wire transfers do not count as direct deposit.
Coupon expiration varies by offer — confirm the date on your specific coupon (third-party sources cite dates like 10/14/2026).
Offer not available to existing Chase checking customers; one bonus per account; one new-checking bonus every two years.

R0536.name: Cash Gift: Accounts maintaining $25,000 or more qualify for a $2,000 cash gift; accounts maintaining between $10,000 and $24,999 qualify for a $1,000 cash gift.
R0536.payout_text: Cash Gift: Accounts maintaining $25,000 or more qualify for a $2,000 cash gift; accounts maintaining between $10,000 and $24,999 qualify for a $1,000 cash gift.
R0536.payout_timing: Cash gift deposited in the new account after all requirements have been met and verified.

steps.text: Visit your local ACNB Bank office to open a Free Business Checking account and use promo code Earn2000.
Within 60 days of opening, enroll in online banking with eDocuments.
Get a Mastercard debit card and make 10 unique transactions within 60 days (allow 2+ days for transactions to post).
Maintain an average monthly balance of $25,000+ (for $2,000) or $10,000-$24,999 (for $1,000) for the three consecutive months following your first statement cycle.
After all requirements are met and verified, the cash gift is deposited directly into your new account.

catches: Account must be opened at a local ACNB Bank office — in-branch only, no online opening.
Use promo code Earn2000; offices apply the code when you open.
Within 60 days of opening: enroll in online banking with eDocuments, and get a Mastercard debit card with 10 unique transactions (posting can take 2+ days).
Bonus tier depends on average monthly balance for three consecutive months following the first statement cycle: $25,000+ = $2,000; $10,000-$24,999 = $1,000.
No stated promo end date — 'Offer is limited and subject to change or cancellation without notice.'

Not for existing Traditions Bank or ACNB Bank business checking customers or anyone who closed a business checking account in the last 12 months; trust/estate accounts, government entities, and municipalities are not eligible.
One gift per entity, up to 3 entities with common ownership; 1099-INT reporting applies.
Only available where ACNB Bank has offices (south-central PA and Maryland via NWSB division).

R0651.name: Earn 75,000 points after you spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.
R0651.payout_text: Earn 75,000 points after you spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.
R0651.payout_timing: Spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. Bonus posts after qualifying purchases, typically 6-8 weeks after the spending requirement is met.

steps.text: Go to the official Chase Sapphire Preferred page and read the current offer headline and the Pricing & Terms before anything else.
Confirm your eligibility: you have not received a Sapphire new-cardmember bonus in the last 48 months and do not currently hold a Sapphire card.
Apply online. Expect a hard credit inquiry.
Use the card for the purchases you were already planning, totaling at least $5,000 in the first 3 months from account opening.
Pay the statement balance in full every month; do not carry a balance at the ~20%+ APR.
Allow 6-8 weeks after the spending requirement is met for the 75,000 points to post, and confirm they appear in your Ultimate Rewards account.
Before the second $95 annual fee hits, decide whether to keep the card or downgrade to a no-fee Chase card based on what the card earns you in normal use.

catches: Only claim this if you were already going to spend the money anyway; never spend extra just to hit the $5,000 minimum, because manufactured spending turns a bonus into debt.

Year-one math: the 75,000-point bonus is worth at least $750 as cash back, minus the $95 annual fee, which leaves about $655 net in year one. From year two the $95 fee applies without any bonus, so only keep the card if the rewards you earn from normal spending beat that $95.

Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which typically knocks a few points off your credit score for a short time. Chase also uses its unpublished 5/24 pattern: applicants with five or more newly opened personal cards across any issuer in the last 24 months are generally denied.
This card's APR is around 20% or higher, so carrying a balance would wipe out the bonus fast. Pay the statement balance in full every month or this offer loses you money.

Chase's unpublished 5/24 pattern: five or more new personal cards opened in the last 24 months generally means denial, even with excellent credit. This is not published in Chase's official terms, so confirm your own history first.

A new Sapphire bonus is not available if you received a Sapphire bonus in the past 48 months or currently hold a Sapphire card. If you fall inside that window, apply only after checking the current application terms.
The account must be open and not in default when the bonus is paid, and the bonus is paid only once per account. Miss a payment around the time the bonus posts and you can lose it.
